exposure: ratio of residual myometrial thickness over the defect to adjacent myometrial thickness
Size of defect (< 30%, 30%-70%, > 70% residual myometrial thickness)
outcome: Success of early termination of pregnancy (TOP) with mifepristone-misoprostol
cohort: 183 women with previous Cesarean delivery who received oral mifepristone and misoprostol for TOP
finding: Women with Cesarean scar defect (CSD) had a higher failure rate of early termination of pregnancy (TOP) with mifepristone-misoprostol compared to women without CSD.
